children: Verde Resources announced a strategic MoU with Highway to pilot and potentially license its engineered biochar Net Zero Blueprint in Singapore.
Wholly owned Singapore unit signed a non-binding 12-month MoU with Highway to validate and commercialize Verde’s engineered biochar platform.
Parties plan an initial pilot with Singapore’s Land Transport Authority to test performance, production readiness, carbon accounting, and MRV.
Subject to pilot success and approvals, parties intend to pursue an exclusive licensing arrangement for Singapore with commercial supply and carbon-credit provisions.
Verde positions Singapore as a regional launchpad to scale the Net Zero Blueprint across Asia-Pacific and support carbon-sequestering infrastructure.
